ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) contrasted against low-intensity black pixel borders and central focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white contiguous regions across both lobes; continuous black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips; a central vertical black cluster at the notch base; isolated small circular black spots on the inner left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an acute internal angle approximately 60-70 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge; distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, upward-inclined distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of yellowish-brown and white pixel groups at both distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization; several low-contrast circular depressions visible on the white ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the left lobe and one distinct vertical mark on the outer right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustation and jagged wear patterns at the lobe tips; unique focal pigmentation spots on the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive, large asymmetrical black anchor-shaped marking extending from the median notch into the visible peduncle area.
